tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. The base ground for every surface.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: nav bar, cards, panels, form fields.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken bands: footer, section dividers that carry a fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and meta rows on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Decorative accent only: icons, rules, large display text 24px and up. Not for body-size text or fills carrying text (3.7:1 on surface-100).

tokens.name: brass-strong
tokens.usage: Text-safe accent: links, active nav and tab state, focus rings, and solid fills paired with on-brass (5.8:1 on surface-100 and surface-200).

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text and icon color set on a brass-strong fill, such as a primary button label.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis rules: card edges, table lines, the strip beneath the nav.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and other control edges that need to read as a boundary (4:1 on surface-100, 3.6:1 on surface-200).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero name and page-level headline. Set once per page.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and intros directly under a display heading.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary copy: card descriptions, form hints, footnotes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Menu-style labels: nav items, eyebrows, tag text. Set in small caps or uppercase in markup.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, bylines and metadata rows beside a title.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label to value, adjacent tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements; card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and the copy beneath it.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; section sub-divisions.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters and the space between major sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and other controls — square enough to read as considered, not soft.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags and the eyebrow's rule-cap dot. Set to half the element's height.
